summary: Engine pickers show each engine's full friendly name on one readable line.
userImpact: The Mission Control engine picker shows the engine name (or its host when unnamed), never a raw engine ID. The open menu widens to fit names and options are no longer clipped.
security: No authorization change. Only the picker's labels and layout change.
rollback: Revert the application image. No data change is involved.
validation: A browser test opens the engine picker with a long name and an unnamed engine and checks full names, single unclipped rows and no raw IDs.
EngineSelector unit tests cover the one-line items and the host fallback label.

customerDocumentation.reason: Layout and notice-condition fixes; no workflow or setting changes for users.
